name: Meeko
summary: Ligand and receptor parameterization for AutoDock docking workflows.

steps: Read the maintainer's installation and CLI documentation; choose a new isolated conda environment for Meeko and its chemistry dependencies.
Review the current conda-forge package and dependency solver output before installation; do not substitute an unreviewed package version or add global channels.
Check mk_prepare_ligand.py and mk_prepare_receptor.py help in the isolated environment. Choose protonation, atom types and receptor flexibility for each scientific case separately.
install.verify_note: Run the maintainer-documented preparation CLI help commands without processing research structures.

notes: Meeko prepares docking inputs and processes outputs; it is not the docking engine itself. The maintainer also documents a PyPI route.
